_provenance.notes: Alaska Tanner crab consists of two species: Chionoecetes bairdi (Bairdi Tanner crab, the larger more valuable species) and C. opilio (Snow crab, or 'Opies'). Snow crab and Bairdi Tanner crab are both referred to as 'Tanner crab' in older records but are managed separately since the 1990s. The snow crab collapse (10 billion animals dead, 2019-2021) was the most dramatic fisheries collapse in modern Alaska history. Bairdi Tanner crab has remained more stable.
